use_jit_decorator: use the jit decorator to wrap a function for Parrots JIT compilation or pass-through
use_skip_no_elena_decorator: use the skip_no_elena decorator to conditionally skip tests when Elena backend is unavailable
check_parrots_jit_option: check the parrots_jit_option variable to see if PARROTS_JIT_OPTION env var is set
summarize_jit_decorator: summarize the jit decorator which provides a no-op fallback when Parrots Torch is not in use
review_skip_no_elena: review the skip_no_elena decorator which imports from parrots or falls back to a pass-through wrapper
